name: app.R
content:
# ===========================================================================
# Congruence Test -- browser app
#
# Bootstrapped congruence-coefficient test for PLS-SEM constructs, from summary
# inputs only. Flow:
#   - Construct scores (N x k) + rho_A  -> bootstrapped significance test
#     (resample score rows, weights held fixed; mildly conservative).
#   - Optional HTMT matrix (k x k)      -> HTMT-based congruence POINT ESTIMATES,
#     shown alongside for comparison (no raw data behind a matrix -> not tested).
#
# Runs client-side in the browser via shinylive (WebAssembly): data never leaves
# the user's machine.
#
# Method: Franke, G. R., Sarstedt, M., & Danks, N. P. (2021). Assessing measure
# congruence in nomological networks. Journal of Business Research, 130, 318-334.
# ===========================================================================

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(DT)

source("R/congruence_core.R")

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0) b else a

# --- Build example paste text from bundled demo files ------------------------
.demo_scores_text <- local({
  df <- utils::read.csv("data/demo_scores.csv", check.names = FALSE)
  hdr <- paste(colnames(df), collapse = "\t")
  body <- apply(df, 1, function(r) paste(formatC(r, digits = 4, format = "f"), collapse = "\t"))
  paste(c(hdr, body), collapse = "\n")
})
.demo_rhoA_text <- local({
  df <- utils::read.csv("data/demo_rhoA.csv", check.names = FALSE)
  paste(apply(df, 1, function(r) paste(trimws(r[1]), trimws(r[2]), sep = "\t")), collapse = "\n")
})
.demo_matrix_text <- paste(readLines("data/demo_matrix.csv"), collapse = "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# UI
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ui <- page_fluid(
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5, primary = "#2C6E9B"),
  tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
    .step-num{display:inline-block;width:1.6rem;height:1.6rem;line-height:1.6rem;
      text-align:center;border-radius:50%;background:#2C6E9B;color:#fff;
      font-weight:600;margin-right:.4rem;}
    .step-opt{background:#8aa;}
    .hint{color:#6c757d;font-size:.85rem;}
    textarea{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:.8rem;}
    .parse-ok{color:#198754;font-weight:600;}
    .parse-err{color:#dc3545;font-weight:600;}
  "))),

  div(class = "container", style = "max-width:1000px;",
    br(),
    h2("Congruence Test for PLS-SEM Constructs"),
    p(class = "text-muted",
      "Test whether pairs of constructs are empirically distinguishable in their ",
      "nomological networks — from summary statistics alone. No raw data or ",
      "model file needed, and everything runs in your browser."),
    div(class = "alert alert-light border py-2",
      tags$small(
        icon("circle-info"),
        " Based on Franke, Sarstedt & Danks (2021), ",
        em("Journal of Business Research"), " 130, 318–334. ",
        "This tool places the reliability measure on the matrix diagonal ",
        "(the published ", tags$code("seminrExtras::congruence_test()"),
        " uses rho_C), and bootstraps the construct scores directly ",
        "(measurement weights held fixed), which is mildly conservative. ",
        "You should use ", strong("rho_A"), " for composite score reliabilities. ",
        "Furthermore, the Franke et al. (2021) paper recommends using construct ",
        "correlations, whereas composite modeling should use the disattenuated ",
        strong("HTMT"), " matrix instead — paste one in Step 3 to compare.")
    ),

    # --- Step 1: construct scores -------------------------------------------
    card(
      card_header(span(class = "step-num", "1"), "Paste your construct scores"),
      card_body(
        p(class = "hint",
          "One column per construct with a header row of construct names, one row ",
          "per case. Copy straight from SmartPLS “Latent Variable Scores” or a ",
          "spreadsheet (tab- or comma-separated). A leading case-id column is ok. ",
          "These drive the bootstrap significance test."),
        textAreaInput("scores", NULL, rows = 8, width = "100%",
                      placeholder = "QUAL\tPERF\tCSOR\t...\n0.12\t-0.34\t0.88\t...\n..."),
        uiOutput("scores_status")
      )
    ),

    # --- Step 2: reliabilities ----------------------------------------------
    card(
      card_header(span(class = "step-num", "2"), "Paste rho_A reliabilities"),
      card_body(
        p(class = "hint",
          "One construct per line: the construct name, then its rho_A value ",
          "(tab-, comma-, or space-separated). Names must match Step 1. ",
          "Formative composites and single items conventionally take rho_A = 1."),
        textAreaInput("rhoa", NULL, rows = 5, width = "100%",
                      placeholder = "QUAL\t0.91\nPERF\t0.88\nCSOR\t0.85\n..."),
        uiOutput("rhoa_status")
      )
    ),

    # --- Step 3: OPTIONAL HTMT matrix ---------------------------------------
    card(
      card_header(span(class = "step-num step-opt", "3"),
                  "Optional: HTMT matrix for comparison"),
      card_body(
        p(class = "hint",
          "A square construct matrix with construct names as both header row and ",
          "first column (full, upper-, or lower-triangular; SmartPLS HTMT is ",
          "lower-triangular). If provided, HTMT-based congruence ",
          strong("point estimates"), " are shown next to the tested, score-based ",
          "ones. The diagonal is ignored — your rho_A values are placed there. ",
          em("HTMT input is not bootstrapped, so it carries no significance test.")),
        textAreaInput("htmt", NULL, rows = 6, width = "100%",
                      placeholder = "(optional)\n\tQUAL\tPERF\tCSOR\nQUAL\nPERF\t0.92\nCSOR\t0.81\t0.74"),
        uiOutput("htmt_status")
      )
    ),

    # --- Options -------------------------------------------------------------
    card(
      card_header("Options"),
      card_body(
        layout_columns(
          col_widths = c(3, 3, 3, 3),
          numericInput("nboot", tooltip(span("Bootstrap samples ", icon("circle-question")),
                       "How many resamples to estimate the standard error. 2000 is standard."),
                       value = 2000, min = 100, max = 10000, step = 100),
          numericInput("seed", tooltip(span("Random seed ", icon("circle-question")),
                       "Fixes the resampling so results are reproducible."),
                       value = 123, min = 1),
          numericInput("alpha", tooltip(span("Alpha ", icon("circle-question")),
                       "Significance level for the confidence interval (e.g. 0.05)."),
                       value = 0.05, min = 0.001, max = 0.5, step = 0.01),
          numericInput("threshold", tooltip(span("Threshold ", icon("circle-question")),
                       "Congruence value tested against (1 = perfect congruence)."),
                       value = 1, min = 0.5, max = 1, step = 0.05)
        )
      )
    ),

    div(class = "d-flex gap-2 mb-3",
      actionButton("run", "Run congruence test", class = "btn-primary btn-lg", icon = icon("play")),
      actionButton("demo", "Load example data", class = "btn-outline-secondary btn-lg", icon = icon("flask"))
    ),

    uiOutput("results_ui")
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Server
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  observeEvent(input$demo, {
    updateTextAreaInput(session, "scores", value = .demo_scores_text)
    updateTextAreaInput(session, "rhoa",   value = .demo_rhoA_text)
    updateTextAreaInput(session, "htmt",   value = .demo_matrix_text)
  })

  # --- parse construct scores ----------------------------------------------
  parsed_scores <- reactive({
    req(nzchar(trimws(input$scores %||% "")))
    tryCatch(parse_scores(input$scores),
             error = function(e) structure(NULL, err = conditionMessage(e)))
  })
  output$scores_status <- renderUI({
    if (!nzchar(trimws(input$scores %||% ""))) return(NULL)
    ps <- parsed_scores()
    if (is.null(ps)) return(span(class = "parse-err", icon("triangle-exclamation"), " ", attr(ps, "err")))
    span(class = "parse-ok", icon("check"),
         sprintf(" %d constructs (%s), %d rows.",
                 ncol(ps), paste(colnames(ps), collapse = ", "), nrow(ps)))
  })

  # --- parse reliabilities --------------------------------------------------
  parsed_rhoa <- reactive({
    req(nzchar(trimws(input$rhoa %||% "")))
    cn <- if (!is.null(parsed_scores())) colnames(parsed_scores()) else NULL
    tryCatch(parse_reliabilities(input$rhoa, cn),
             error = function(e) structure(NULL, err = conditionMessage(e)))
  })
  output$rhoa_status <- renderUI({
    if (!nzchar(trimws(input$rhoa %||% ""))) return(NULL)
    pr <- parsed_rhoa()
    if (is.null(pr)) return(span(class = "parse-err", icon("triangle-exclamation"), " ", attr(pr, "err")))
    span(class = "parse-ok", icon("check"),
         sprintf(" %d reliabilities: %s", length(pr),
                 paste(names(pr), round(pr, 3), sep = "=", collapse = ", ")))
  })

  # --- parse optional HTMT matrix ------------------------------------------
  parsed_htmt <- reactive({
    if (!nzchar(trimws(input$htmt %||% ""))) return(NULL)
    tryCatch(parse_matrix(input$htmt),
             error = function(e) structure(NULL, err = conditionMessage(e)))
  })
  output$htmt_status <- renderUI({
    if (!nzchar(trimws(input$htmt %||% ""))) return(NULL)
    ph <- parsed_htmt()
    if (is.null(ph)) return(span(class = "parse-err", icon("triangle-exclamation"), " ", attr(ph, "err")))
    ps <- parsed_scores()
    msg <- sprintf(" %d×%d HTMT matrix — constructs: %s.", nrow(ph), ncol(ph),
                   paste(colnames(ph), collapse = ", "))
    if (!is.null(ps) && !all(colnames(ps) %in% colnames(ph))) {
      return(span(class = "parse-err", icon("triangle-exclamation"),
                  " HTMT constructs do not match the construct scores."))
    }
    span(class = "parse-ok", icon("check"), msg)
  })

  # --- run ------------------------------------------------------------------
  result <- eventReactive(input$run, {
    ps <- parsed_scores(); pr <- parsed_rhoa()
    validate(
      need(!is.null(ps), attr(ps, "err") %||% "Paste a valid construct-scores matrix."),
      need(!is.null(pr), attr(pr, "err") %||% "Paste valid rho_A reliabilities.")
    )
    res <- withProgress(message = "Bootstrapping congruence coefficients...", value = 0.5, {
      tryCatch(
        congruence_from_scores(ps, pr, nboot = input$nboot, seed = input$seed,
                               alpha = input$alpha, threshold = input$threshold),
        error = function(e) structure(NULL, err = conditionMessage(e)))
    })
    if (is.null(res)) return(res)

    # Optional HTMT comparison (point estimates).
    ph <- parsed_htmt()
    if (!is.null(ph)) {
      cn <- colnames(ps)
      if (!all(cn %in% colnames(ph))) {
        return(structure(NULL, err = "HTMT matrix constructs must match the construct scores."))
      }
      ph <- ph[cn, cn]  # align order so Pair labels match the score-based table
      hm <- tryCatch(congruence_from_matrix(ph, pr, threshold = input$threshold),
                     error = function(e) structure(NULL, err = conditionMessage(e)))
      if (is.null(hm)) return(structure(NULL, err = attr(hm, "err")))
      res$`HTMT rc`        <- hm$`Original Est.`[match(res$Pair, hm$Pair)]
      res$`HTMT − Score`   <- res$`HTMT rc` - res$`Original Est.`
      # Reorder: comparison columns right after the score-based estimate.
      ord <- c("Pair", "Original Est.", "HTMT rc", "HTMT − Score",
               setdiff(names(res), c("Pair", "Original Est.", "HTMT rc", "HTMT − Score")))
      res <- res[, ord]
      attr(res, "has_htmt") <- TRUE
      attr(res, "threshold") <- input$threshold
      attr(res, "inference") <- TRUE
    }
    res
  })

  has_htmt <- function(res) isTRUE(attr(res, "has_htmt"))

  output$results_ui <- renderUI({
    res <- result()
    if (is.null(res)) {
      if (!is.null(attr(res, "err")))
        return(div(class = "alert alert-danger", icon("triangle-exclamation"), " ", attr(res, "err")))
      return(NULL)
    }
    tagList(
      h3("Results"),
      uiOutput("interpretation"),
      card(card_header("Congruence coefficients"), card_body(DTOutput("table"))),
      if (has_htmt(res))
        card(card_header("Score-based vs HTMT-based congruence"),
             card_body(plotOutput("compare_plot", height = "420px"))),
      layout_columns(
        col_widths = c(7, 5),
        card(card_header("Congruence heatmap (score-based)"),
             card_body(plotOutput("heatmap", height = "420px"))),
        card(card_header("Downloads"), card_body(
          p(class = "hint", "Save the results table, or copy reproducible R code."),
          downloadButton("dl_csv", "Download results (CSV)", class = "btn-outline-primary mb-2"),
          tags$details(tags$summary("Show reproducible R code"),
                       tags$pre(style = "font-size:.75rem;", textOutput("rcode", container = pre)))
        ))
      )
    )
  })

  output$interpretation <- renderUI({
    res <- result(); req(!is.null(res))
    thr <- attr(res, "threshold")
    risky <- res$Pair[!res$Significant]
    banner <- if (length(risky) == 0) {
      div(class = "alert alert-success",
          icon("check"), strong(" All pairs are significantly distinguishable"),
          sprintf(" (score-based congruence credibly below %.2f). No redundancy flagged.", thr))
    } else {
      div(class = "alert alert-warning",
          icon("triangle-exclamation"),
          strong(sprintf(" %d pair(s) not significantly below %.2f", length(risky), thr)),
          " — redundancy cannot be ruled out for: ",
          tags$br(), em(paste(risky, collapse = ";  ")))
    }
    if (has_htmt(res)) {
      tagList(banner,
        div(class = "alert alert-secondary py-2", tags$small(
          icon("circle-info"),
          " The HTMT columns are disattenuated point estimates for comparison only ",
          "— they are not bootstrapped and carry no significance test.")))
    } else banner
  })

  output$table <- renderDT({
    res <- result(); req(!is.null(res))
    disp <- res
    disp$Significant <- ifelse(disp$Significant, "✓", "⚠")
    num_cols <- setdiff(names(disp), c("Pair", "Significant"))
    dt <- datatable(disp, rownames = FALSE, selection = "none",
                    options = list(paging = FALSE, searching = FALSE, info = FALSE,
                                   dom = "t", ordering = TRUE)) |>
      formatRound(num_cols, digits = 4)
    formatStyle(dt, "Significant", target = "row",
                backgroundColor = styleEqual(c("✓", "⚠"), c("transparent", "#fff3cd")))
  })

  output$heatmap <- renderPlot({
    res <- result(); req(!is.null(res))
    cn <- unique(unlist(strsplit(res$Pair, " -> ", fixed = TRUE)))
    k <- length(cn)
    m <- matrix(NA_real_, k, k, dimnames = list(cn, cn))
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(res))) {
      pr <- strsplit(res$Pair[i], " -> ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      m[pr[1], pr[2]] <- m[pr[2], pr[1]] <- res$`Original Est.`[i]
    }
    diag(m) <- 1
    op <- par(mar = c(6, 6, 1, 1)); on.exit(par(op))
    pal <- colorRampPalette(c("#2C6E9B", "#f7f7f7", "#c0392b"))(100)
    image(seq_len(k), seq_len(k), t(m[k:1, ]), col = pal, zlim = c(min(m, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
          axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
    axis(1, at = seq_len(k), labels = cn, las = 2)
    axis(2, at = seq_len(k), labels = rev(cn), las = 2)
    for (i in seq_len(k)) for (j in seq_len(k)) {
      v <- m[k:1, ][j, i]
      if (!is.na(v)) text(i, j, sprintf("%.2f", v), cex = 0.8)
    }
  })

  output$compare_plot <- renderPlot({
    res <- result(); req(!is.null(res), has_htmt(res))
    x <- res$`Original Est.`; y <- res$`HTMT rc`
    lim <- range(c(x, y), na.rm = TRUE)
    op <- par(mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 1, 1)); on.exit(par(op))
    plot(x, y, xlim = lim, ylim = lim, pch = 19, col = "#2C6E9B",
         xlab = "Congruence from construct scores (tested)",
         ylab = "Congruence from HTMT (point estimate)")
    abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = "grey50")
    text(x, y, labels = res$Pair, pos = 3, cex = 0.6, col = "grey30")
  })

  output$dl_csv <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() "congruence_results.csv",
    content = function(file) utils::write.csv(result(), file, row.names = FALSE)
  )

  output$rcode <- renderText({
    req(!is.null(result()))
    rel_line <- paste0("  ", paste(sprintf("%s = %.4f", names(parsed_rhoa()), parsed_rhoa()),
                                   collapse = ", "))
    paste(
      "# Reproduce the tested (score-based) analysis in base R:",
      "scores <- as.matrix(read.csv('construct_scores.csv'))",
      "rhoA   <- c(", rel_line, ")",
      "calc <- function(m, X, Y) sum(m[,X]*m[,Y]) / sqrt(sum(m[,X]^2)*sum(m[,Y]^2))",
      sprintf("set.seed(%d); nboot <- %d; threshold <- %g", input$seed, input$nboot, input$threshold),
      "cn <- colnames(scores); combns <- t(combn(cn, 2)); n <- nrow(scores)",
      "boot <- matrix(NA, nrow(combns), nboot)",
      "for (b in 1:nboot) { m <- cor(scores[sample(n,n,TRUE),]); diag(m) <- rhoA[cn]",
      "  for (r in 1:nrow(combns)) boot[r,b] <- calc(m, combns[r,1], combns[r,2]) }",
      "m0 <- cor(scores); diag(m0) <- rhoA[cn]",
      "orig <- sapply(1:nrow(combns), function(r) calc(m0, combns[r,1], combns[r,2]))",
      "data.frame(pair = paste(combns[,1], combns[,2]), rc = orig,",
      "  t = (threshold - abs(orig)) / apply(boot,1,sd))",
      sep = "\n")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

name: R/congruence_core.R
content:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core computation for the Congruence Test web app.
#
# This is a summary-statistics re-implementation of the mechanics inside
# seminrExtras::congruence_test(). Instead of resampling raw indicator data and
# re-estimating the whole PLS model each bootstrap iteration, we resample rows of
# the *construct-scores* matrix (measurement weights held fixed) and recompute
# the congruence coefficients. Validated against the published bootstrap on two
# models: point estimates are identical; bootstrap SEs run ~10% wider (mildly
# conservative). See README.md for details.
#
# Deliberate divergence from congruence_test(): the reliability placed on the
# matrix diagonal is rho_A here (the user's choice), whereas the published
# function uses rho_C. Results are therefore a rho_A variant.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Congruence coefficient between columns X and Y of `mat`.
# rc = sum(X*Y) / sqrt(sum(X^2) * sum(Y^2)) -- cosine similarity of the two
# correlation-pattern vectors. Identical to the formula in congruence_test().
calc_congruence <- function(mat, X, Y) {
  sum(mat[, X] * mat[, Y]) / sqrt(sum(mat[, X]^2) * sum(mat[, Y]^2))
}

# Build the base matrix: correlation of construct scores, with the diagonal
# replaced by the supplied reliabilities (rho_A), ordered to match `scores`.
build_base_matrix <- function(scores, reliabilities) {
  m <- stats::cor(scores)
  diag(m) <- reliabilities[colnames(m)]
  m
}

# Main entry point.
#   scores        : numeric matrix/data.frame, N rows x k constructs (named cols)
#   reliabilities : named numeric vector, one rho_A per construct
#   nboot, seed, alpha, threshold : as in congruence_test()
# Returns a data.frame with one row per construct pair and columns matching the
# congruence_test() output, plus a logical `Significant` flag.
congruence_from_scores <- function(scores,
                                   reliabilities,
                                   nboot = 2000,
                                   seed = 123,
                                   alpha = 0.05,
                                   threshold = 1) {
  scores <- as.matrix(scores)
  cn <- colnames(scores)

  # --- validation -----------------------------------------------------------
  if (is.null(cn) || any(cn == "")) {
    stop("The scores matrix must have a construct name for every column.")
  }
  if (ncol(scores) < 2) {
    stop("Need at least two constructs (columns) to test congruence.")
  }
  if (nrow(scores) < 3) {
    stop("Need at least three observations (rows) to bootstrap.")
  }
  if (is.null(names(reliabilities))) {
    # allow positional supply: match to score columns in order
    if (length(reliabilities) != length(cn)) {
      stop("Supply one reliability per construct, named or in column order.")
    }
    names(reliabilities) <- cn
  }
  missing_rel <- setdiff(cn, names(reliabilities))
  if (length(missing_rel)) {
    stop("Missing reliability for: ", paste(missing_rel, collapse = ", "))
  }
  reliabilities <- reliabilities[cn]
  if (any(!is.finite(reliabilities)) || any(reliabilities <= 0 | reliabilities > 1)) {
    stop("Reliabilities must be finite and in (0, 1].")
  }

  set.seed(seed)
  combns <- t(utils::combn(cn, 2))
  n <- nrow(scores)

  # --- point estimates ------------------------------------------------------
  base_mat <- build_base_matrix(scores, reliabilities)
  orig <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(combns)),
                 function(r) calc_congruence(base_mat, combns[r, 1], combns[r, 2]),
                 numeric(1))

  # --- bootstrap on construct-score rows ------------------------------------
  boot <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(combns), ncol = nboot)
  for (b in seq_len(nboot)) {
    s <- scores[sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
    m <- stats::cor(s)
    diag(m) <- reliabilities
    for (r in seq_len(nrow(combns))) {
      boot[r, b] <- calc_congruence(m, combns[r, 1], combns[r, 2])
    }
  }

  boot_sd <- apply(boot, 1, stats::sd)
  diff    <- threshold - abs(orig)
  tstat   <- ifelse(boot_sd < .Machine$double.eps, NA_real_, diff / boot_sd)
  ci_lo   <- apply(boot, 1, stats::quantile, probs = alpha / 2,     names = FALSE)
  ci_hi   <- apply(boot, 1, stats::quantile, probs = 1 - alpha / 2, names = FALSE)

  # A pair is "significant" when rc is credibly BELOW the threshold -- the whole
  # bootstrap CI lies under it -- meaning the two constructs are empirically
  # distinguishable (no redundancy in their nomological nets). NON-significant
  # pairs are the ones to worry about: redundancy cannot be ruled out.
  significant <- ci_hi < threshold

  lo_lab <- paste0(alpha / 2 * 100, "% CI")
  hi_lab <- paste0((1 - alpha / 2) * 100, "% CI")

  out <- data.frame(
    Pair          = paste(combns[, 1], "->", combns[, 2]),
    `Original Est.` = orig,
    Diff          = diff,
    `Bootstrap SD` = boot_sd,
    `T Stat.`     = tstat,
    lo            = ci_lo,
    hi            = ci_hi,
    Significant   = significant,
    check.names   = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  names(out)[names(out) == "lo"] <- lo_lab
  names(out)[names(out) == "hi"] <- hi_lab
  attr(out, "threshold") <- threshold
  attr(out, "alpha") <- alpha
  attr(out, "nboot") <- nboot
  attr(out, "inference") <- TRUE
  out
}

# Point-estimate congruence from a supplied construct matrix (correlation or
# disattenuated HTMT). No raw data behind the matrix, so NO bootstrap -- this
# returns congruence coefficients only, not a significance test.
#   mat           : square k x k numeric matrix, named (off-diagonal complete)
#   reliabilities : named rho_A vector; placed on the diagonal
congruence_from_matrix <- function(mat, reliabilities, threshold = 1) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  cn <- colnames(mat)
  if (is.null(cn) || any(cn == "")) stop("The matrix must have a name for every construct.")
  if (nrow(mat) != ncol(mat)) stop("The matrix must be square.")
  if (ncol(mat) < 2) stop("Need at least two constructs.")

  if (is.null(names(reliabilities))) {
    if (length(reliabilities) != length(cn)) stop("Supply one reliability per construct, named or in order.")
    names(reliabilities) <- cn
  }
  missing_rel <- setdiff(cn, names(reliabilities))
  if (length(missing_rel)) stop("Missing reliability for: ", paste(missing_rel, collapse = ", "))
  reliabilities <- reliabilities[cn]
  if (any(!is.finite(reliabilities)) || any(reliabilities <= 0 | reliabilities > 1)) {
    stop("Reliabilities must be finite and in (0, 1].")
  }

  m <- mat
  diag(m) <- reliabilities
  if (anyNA(m)) stop("The matrix has empty off-diagonal cells -- paste a complete matrix (or a full triangle).")

  combns <- t(utils::combn(cn, 2))
  orig <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(combns)),
                 function(r) calc_congruence(m, combns[r, 1], combns[r, 2]), numeric(1))
  out <- data.frame(
    Pair            = paste(combns[, 1], "->", combns[, 2]),
    `Original Est.` = orig,
    Diff            = threshold - abs(orig),
    check.names     = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  attr(out, "threshold") <- threshold
  attr(out, "inference") <- FALSE
  out
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flexible paste parsers (Excel/SmartPLS copy-paste is tab-separated; CSV is
# comma-separated; some exports are whitespace-separated).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Strip a single pair of surrounding quotes (either kind) from a token, so that
# `"QUAL"` (quoted CSV export) and `QUAL` (bare) parse identically.
.unquote <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- sub('^["\']', "", x)
  x <- sub('["\']$', "", x)
  trimws(x)
}

# Detect delimiter from the first non-empty data line.
.detect_sep <- function(txt) {
  line <- txt[nzchar(trimws(txt))][1]
  if (is.na(line)) return(",")
  if (grepl("\t", line)) return("\t")
  if (grepl(",", line))  return(",")
  "[[:space:]]+"
}

# Parse the pasted construct-scores block into a numeric matrix with named cols.
# First row must be the header of construct names.
parse_scores <- function(text) {
  text <- gsub("\r", "", text)
  lines <- strsplit(text, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lines <- lines[nzchar(trimws(lines))]
  if (length(lines) < 2) stop("Paste a header row of construct names plus at least two data rows.")
  sep <- .detect_sep(lines)
  split_line <- function(l) .unquote(strsplit(l, sep)[[1]])

  header <- split_line(lines[1])
  header <- header[nzchar(header)]
  body <- lines[-1]

  rows <- lapply(body, function(l) {
    v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(split_line(l)))
    v[!is.na(v) | seq_along(v) <= length(header)]  # keep alignment
  })
  # If a leading row-id column was pasted (one more value than headers), drop it.
  ncols <- vapply(rows, length, integer(1))
  if (all(ncols == length(header) + 1)) {
    rows <- lapply(rows, function(v) v[-1])
  }
  mat <- tryCatch(do.call(rbind, rows), error = function(e)
    stop("Rows have inconsistent numbers of values -- check the pasted matrix."))
  storage.mode(mat) <- "double"
  if (anyNA(mat)) stop("Non-numeric or missing values found in the scores matrix.")
  if (ncol(mat) != length(header)) {
    stop(sprintf("Header has %d names but data has %d columns.", length(header), ncol(mat)))
  }
  colnames(mat) <- make.names(header, unique = TRUE)
  mat
}

# Parse a pasted square construct matrix (correlation or HTMT). Handles:
#   - a header row of construct names (with or without a leading corner cell),
#   - a leading column of row-label names,
#   - full, upper-, or lower-triangular fills (empty cells become NA, then the
#     matrix is symmetrised from whichever triangle is present),
#   - quoted or unquoted names/numbers.
# The diagonal is ignored (reliabilities are placed there later).
parse_matrix <- function(text) {
  text <- gsub("\r", "", text)
  lines <- strsplit(text, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lines <- lines[nzchar(trimws(lines))]
  if (length(lines) < 2) stop("Paste a square matrix with construct names as headers.")
  sep <- .detect_sep(lines)
  split_line <- function(l) .unquote(strsplit(l, sep)[[1]])

  header <- split_line(lines[1])
  # Drop a leading empty corner cell if present.
  if (length(header) && !nzchar(header[1])) header <- header[-1]
  header <- header[nzchar(header)]
  if (length(header) < 2) stop("Could not read construct names from the header row.")
  if (!all(is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(header))))) {
    stop("The first row must be construct names, not numbers.")
  }

  body <- lines[-1]
  k <- length(header)
  M <- matrix(NA_real_, k, k, dimnames = list(header, header))

  # Row-labelled if the first body token is non-numeric.
  first_tok <- split_line(body[1])[1]
  has_rowlabels <- is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(first_tok)))

  for (ri in seq_along(body)) {
    toks <- split_line(body[ri])
    if (has_rowlabels) {
      rn <- toks[1]
      if (!(rn %in% header)) stop("Row name '", rn, "' is not among the column names.")
      vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(toks[-1]))
      ncell <- min(length(vals), k)
      M[rn, header[seq_len(ncell)]] <- vals[seq_len(ncell)]
    } else {
      if (ri > k) stop("More data rows than constructs.")
      vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(toks))
      ncell <- min(length(vals), k)
      M[ri, seq_len(ncell)] <- vals[seq_len(ncell)]
    }
  }

  # Symmetrise from whichever triangle is filled.
  for (i in seq_len(k)) for (j in seq_len(k)) {
    if (is.na(M[i, j]) && !is.na(M[j, i])) M[i, j] <- M[j, i]
  }
  off <- M; diag(off) <- 0
  if (anyNA(off)) stop("Incomplete matrix: some off-diagonal cells are empty even after mirroring.")
  colnames(M) <- rownames(M) <- make.names(header, unique = TRUE)
  M
}

# Parse the pasted reliabilities. Accepts either:
#   - "construct<sep>value" lines (order-independent, matched by name), or
#   - a single line/column of k values (matched positionally to score columns).
parse_reliabilities <- function(text, construct_names = NULL) {
  text <- gsub("\r", "", text)
  lines <- strsplit(text, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lines <- lines[nzchar(trimws(lines))]
  if (length(lines) == 0) stop("Paste the rho_A reliability values.")
  sep <- .detect_sep(lines)

  first <- .unquote(strsplit(lines[1], sep)[[1]])
  first <- first[nzchar(first)]

  # Case 1: name + value pairs.
  if (length(lines) >= 2 && length(first) >= 2 && is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(first[1])))) {
    nm <- character(0); val <- numeric(0)
    for (l in lines) {
      parts <- .unquote(strsplit(l, sep)[[1]])
      parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
      if (length(parts) < 2) next
      # skip an obvious header line like "construct rhoA"
      v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[length(parts)]))
      if (is.na(v)) next
      nm <- c(nm, make.names(parts[1]))
      val <- c(val, v)
    }
    if (length(val) == 0) stop("Could not parse any construct/value pairs from the reliabilities.")
    names(val) <- nm
    return(val)
  }

  # Case 2: bare numbers (one per line, or one row).
  nums <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(lapply(lines, function(l) {
    .unquote(strsplit(l, sep)[[1]])
  }))))
  nums <- nums[!is.na(nums)]
  if (length(nums) == 0) stop("Could not parse any numeric reliabilities.")
  if (!is.null(construct_names)) {
    if (length(nums) != length(construct_names)) {
      stop(sprintf("Got %d reliabilities but %d constructs.",
                   length(nums), length(construct_names)))
    }
    names(nums) <- construct_names
  }
  nums
}
